newsitem.title: USA: Chicago treasurer wants panel to pick banks.
newsitem.headline: Chicago treasurer wants panel to pick banks.

text.p: Chicago Treasurer Miriam Santos wants to create a seven-member panel to review banks seeking to serve as depositories for billions in city funds, the deputy treasurer said Monday.
Currently, the city comptroller advertises for bids from banks to serve as depositories for city and board of education funds and passes recommendations to the City Council for approval.

Under the Santos proposal, which failed to receive even a subcommittee hearing in the City Council previously, the treasurer, comptroller and five mayoral appointees would review the bids, Deputy Treasurer Laurie Dittman said.
Santos plans to reintroduce the proposed ordinance in the fall, Dittman said.
"The same thing could happen, but it is important to keep pushing for it," Dittman said.
The number of qualified depositories has increased recently, Dittman said, but the new ordinance would permit the panel to evaluate a bank's community lending practices as well.
